brand.name: TROIE Studio
brand.tagline: Strategy, creative and ongoing support, in Nice.
brand.metaDescription: Strategy and creative studio in Nice, France. We shape your brand with you, then our team makes the photos, videos and websites. First 30-minute call.
brand.organizationDescription: TROIE Studio is a strategy and creative studio based in Nice, France, founded by Hugues Lourmieres. Brand strategy, art direction, photography, video, websites and ongoing support for businesses in France, Monaco and abroad.

home.introTitle: We decide with you.|We make it for you.
home.introBody: A studio in Nice, France. We get to know your brand and your market, then decide with you what to say, to whom and where. Then our team makes it happen: photo, video, websites, content. And we stay by your side.
home.worksIntro: Luxury houses, hospitality, sport, industry, technology. Project details available on request.
home.videosIntro: Client testimonials, brand films and storytelling. A selection of video productions for Rutherford, GS Monaco × Forbes, Autajon, LEFRANCQ and others.
home.bandText: A project, a question about your brand or your website? Let's talk for thirty minutes.
home.ctaSubtitle: Thirty minutes to understand where you stand and what you aim for. Then we send you a written proposal and a quote.
home.heroNote: A first 30-minute call. Then a written proposal and a quote.
home.heroSignature: Hugues Lourmieres, founder. Marketing director, photographer and filmmaker.
home.cardStrategyTitle: Know what to say, and to whom.
home.cardStrategyBody: Positioning, message, choice of channels, acquisition plan. We read your market with the eye of a working marketing director. Then we decide with you where to put the effort.
home.cardStrategyImageAlt: Building facade, black and white photograph
home.cardCreationBody: We shoot, photograph and edit ourselves, in the studio and on location. We design and build your websites. AI speeds up the making. It decides nothing.
home.cardCreationImageAlt: The Mercantour, a series by Hugues Lourmieres
home.cardSupportBody: Fractional marketing direction, workshops with your teams, getting started with your tools. We follow your projects after delivery, with you and your suppliers.
home.cardSupportImageAlt: Hands on a laptop during a workshop
home.mediasBody: Photo, video and art direction for luxury houses, manufacturers and Riviera brands. Some projects were made by Hugues in-house, at CHANEL and Rutherford.
home.mediasPersonal: Valberg and Wildlife are Hugues's personal series. He shares more on Instagram,

works.pageSubtitle: A curated set of projects shot for the brands we work with: luxury houses, hospitality, industry, sport and nature.

chanel.title: CHANEL
chanel.subtitle: Southern boutiques, teams, atmosphere and craft
chanel.description: An in-house series for the House, focused on the boutiques of the South. Photographing the teams in their daily life, gestures, glances, the light of the sales floor, serving internal well-being as much as elevating the products themselves. An intimate reportage that reveals the brand's DNA through the people who embody it day after day.

monaco.title: Monaco
monaco.subtitle: Premium evenings and events on the Riviera
monaco.description: Private event coverage in Monaco and on the French Riviera: galas, launches, exceptional evenings.

veoria.title: Veoria
veoria.subtitle: Corporate culture and team photography
veoria.scope: Corporate photography, teams, culture, social media
veoria.description: One day with the Veoria team, documenting culture and commitment, delivering a ready-to-use visual library for social media and internal communications.

mibi-2026.title: MIBI 2026
mibi-2026.subtitle: National convention, event coverage
mibi-2026.description: Full coverage of the MIBI 2026 convention: keynotes, workshops, off moments, portraits.

cartonajes-pans.title: Cartonajes Pans
cartonajes-pans.subtitle: Industrial reportage in Barcelona
cartonajes-pans.description: Full reportage for Cartonajes Pans in Barcelona: workshops, presses in action, color demos and testimonials. Documentary photography in black and white and color.

wauters-bpack.title: Wauters B'Pack
wauters-bpack.subtitle: Printing, offset presses and content
wauters-bpack.description: Industrial reportage and social-media content production for Wauters B'Pack. Capturing presses in action and operators at work, a series usable across every channel.

capefront.title: Capefront
capefront.subtitle: Brand identity and photography
capefront.description: Brand photography for Capefront. A series that balances corporate precision with natural lifestyle, embodying the brand across every touchpoint.

eshuis.title: Eshuis
eshuis.subtitle: Reportage and art direction
eshuis.description: Reportage and art direction for Eshuis. A series of portraits and workshop scenes that tell the craft and the people behind it.

social-media.title: Social Media
social-media.subtitle: Art direction and content for the feeds
social-media.description: A grounded brand aesthetic and social-media content tailored to each platform. Art direction, stories, posts, reels.

valberg.title: Valberg
valberg.subtitle: Mercantour landscapes
valberg.scope: Landscape photography, black and white, prints
valberg.description: A photographic series shot in the Mercantour, around Valberg. Composing with landscape, experiencing the truth of nature.

animaux.title: Wildlife
animaux.subtitle: Wildlife photography
animaux.description: Capturing the emotion of wildlife. Showing the raw beauty of nature, at animal level.
